Class GameInstance

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am28.Network.Server.GameInstance
public class GameInstance extends Object
Represents an instance of a game, managing player connections, game state, and interactions between the server and clients. Each instance corresponds to a single game configuration and facilitates gameplay for multiple connected players.

      public GameInstance(String playerNickname, PlayerColor playerColor, int gameLevel, int totalPlayers, VirtualView virtualClient) throws Exception
      Constructs a new game instance of the game with the specified parameters.
      Parameters:
      playerNickname - the nickname of the player who initiates the game
      playerColor - the color chosen by the player
      gameLevel - the level of the game to be played
      totalPlayers - the total number of players who can join the game
      virtualClient - the client's virtual view (connection protocol) used to interact with the game
      Throws:
      Exception - if an error occurs during the game configuration

    • gameConfig

      private void gameConfig(String playerNickname, PlayerColor playerColor, int gameLevel, int totalPlayers, VirtualView virtualClient) throws Exception
      Configures the game instance based on the provided information. This includes initializing game settings, broadcasting the game state to connected clients, and allowing new connections.
      Parameters:
      playerNickname - the nickname of the player initiating the game configuration
      playerColor - the color chosen by the player
      gameLevel - the level of the game to be played
      totalPlayers - the total number of players to participate in the game
      virtualClient - the virtual client view used for interaction with the server
      Throws:
      Exception - if an error occurs during the game configuration process

      public void addNewPlayer(String playerNickname, PlayerColor playerColor, VirtualView virtualClient) throws Exception
      Adds a new player to the game instance. This method updates the game state to include the new player, broadcasts the updated game state to all connected clients, and manages the connection of the new client's virtual view.
      Parameters:
      playerNickname - the nickname of the player joining the game
      playerColor - the color chosen by the player
      virtualClient - the client's virtual view (connection protocol) used to interact with the game
      Throws:
      Exception - if an error occurs while adding the new player or broadcasting updates

      public void selectDeselectSubdeck(String player, Integer selectedDeck, Boolean isSelectAction) throws Exception
      Allows a player to select or deselect a specific subdeck in the game. This action updates the game state to reflect the change and broadcasts the updated state to all connected clients.

    • sendUpdateWithRetries

      public static void sendUpdateWithRetries(VirtualView view, Answer answer, Queue queueHandler, int currentAttempt, int maxRetries, long delay)
      Sends an update to the given VirtualView with retry logic. If the first attempt fails, the method retries the operation up to the specified maximum number of retries, adding a delay between each attempt. If all retries fail, the failure is logged.
      Parameters:
      view - the virtual view where the update is intended to be sent
      answer - the answer object containing the update details
      queueHandler - the queue handler used for task execution
      currentAttempt - the current attempt number for sending the update
      maxRetries - the maximum number of retry attempts
      delay - the delay in milliseconds between each retry attempt
